year_synthesis: 1936 strengthens the distinction between publication identity and repeated surface style.
Real inserted objects continue to function as evidence rather than decoration.
The 9-10-11-12 quadruple issue proves that subject scale can rewrite cadence, physical form, page count and sequence together.
A special issue is not a larger normal issue; its content can generate a different publication architecture.
Technical processes remain editorial material only when judgement gives them semantic purpose.
